# ==============================================================================
# Rule #14 Runtime Mode Helpers (Dev Panel Page 75 & Audit Event oe_cri2.16)
# ==============================================================================

oe_cri2_set_mode_historic = {
	remove_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_off
	remove_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_mild
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_cri2_mode_historic value = 1 }
}

oe_cri2_set_mode_mild = {
	remove_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_off
	remove_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_historic
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_cri2_mode_mild value = 1 }
}

oe_cri2_set_mode_off = {
	remove_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_historic
	remove_global_variable = oe_cri2_mode_mild
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_cri2_mode_off value = 1 }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Market & Progress Helpers
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Safely increment Little Ice Age relief score by $amount$.
oe_cri2_bump_lia_relief = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cri2_lia_relief_score }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cri2_lia_relief_score add = $amount$ }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_lia_relief_score value = $amount$ }
	}
}

# Country scope. Safely increment Silver Price Revolution reform steps by $amount$.
oe_cri2_bump_silver_reform = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_cri2_silver_reform_steps }
		change_variable = { name = oe_cri2_silver_reform_steps add = $amount$ }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_silver_reform_steps value = $amount$ }
	}
}

# Country scope. Inject wheat supply & famine-relief special demand into capital market and relieve starving provinces.
oe_cri2_inject_famine_relief_market = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = market }
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:wheat amount = 30 }
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cri2_lia_famine_relief_demand years = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	every_province = {
		limit = { is_starving = yes }
		change_province_food_percentage = 0.25
	}
}

# Country scope. Inject real silver bullion supply & luxury demand across 5 Eurasian hubs + non-overlapping capital.
oe_cri2_inject_silver_tide_markets = {
	location:constantinople = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:silver amount = 25 }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cri2_silver_tide_luxury_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:venice = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:silver amount = 25 }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cri2_silver_tide_luxury_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:genoa = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:silver amount = 25 }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cri2_silver_tide_luxury_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:jinjiang = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:silver amount = 25 }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cri2_silver_tide_luxury_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:alexandria = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:silver amount = 25 }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cri2_silver_tide_luxury_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			NOT = { capital = location:constantinople }
			NOT = { capital = location:venice }
			NOT = { capital = location:genoa }
			NOT = { capital = location:jinjiang }
			NOT = { capital = location:alexandria }
		}
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = market }
				market = {
					add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:silver amount = 25 }
					add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cri2_silver_tide_luxury_demand years = 3 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Dev Panel Page 75: simulate Little Ice Age + Egypt/Haiyun grain & steppe frost chain.
oe_cri2_dev_lia_sim = {
	remove_variable = oe_cri2_lia_cooldown
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_lia_resilient_agriculture
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cri2_lia_relief_score } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_lia_relief_score value = 0 }
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.1
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.3
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.4
}

# Country scope. Dev Panel Page 75: activate global Silver Tide, inject hub markets & fire key silver events.
oe_cri2_dev_silver_sim = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_cri2_silver_tide_active value = 1 }
	remove_variable = oe_cri2_silver_cooldown
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_silver_standard_reformed
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cri2_silver_reform_steps } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_silver_reform_steps value = 0 }
	}
	oe_cri2_inject_silver_tide_markets = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.7
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.9
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.12
}

# Country scope. Dev Panel Page 75: spawn a live peasant/burgher rebel to test 500_oe_cri2_rebel_demands auto-matching.
oe_cri2_dev_rebel_test = {
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_charter_peasant_relief
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_charter_free_cities
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_charter_noble_magna_carta
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_charter_religious_toleration
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_charter_cossack_hetmanate
	remove_country_modifier = oe_cri2_charter_steppe_autonomy
	create_rebel = {
		name = oe_cri2_test_charter_rebels
		category = estate
		estate = peasants_estate
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cri2.16
}

# Country scope. Standalone W4 dev-only toggle to test W1 cabinet discount synergy prior to Stage merge.
oe_cri2_dev_sim_w1_synergy = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_granary_active_flag value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag value = 1 }
}

oe_cri2_dev_clear_w1_synergy = {
	remove_variable = oe_dip2_granary_active_flag
	remove_variable = oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag
}
